facts.text: Pitt-Greensburg offers over 100 programs that students can begin in Greensburg and complete at the Pittsburgh campus.

sources.title: Path to Pittsburgh Campus - Pitt-Greensburg
sources.quote: Pitt-Greensburg works closely with the Pittsburgh campus schools to offer over 100 programs that can be started in Greensburg and completed in Pittsburgh.

facts.text: Competitive full-tuition scholarships cover up to 18 credits per semester for four years for students maintaining a 3.5 GPA.

sources.title: Full-Tuition Scholarship Competition - Pitt-Greensburg
sources.quote: This award will cover tuition of up to 18 credits per semester (in-state rate) for up to 4 years if the student meets renewal criteria of 3.5 GPA each academic year.
